question: Does the generated macOS Quick Action ('Als Microblog-Snippet speichern') appear in the right-click Services menu and pass selected text to the app?
probes: Person clicks 'Rechtsklick-Dienst einrichten' in Einstellungen, selects text in Safari, right-click → Dienste
resolution: Confirmed by the person (2026-11-23): the Quick Action appears in the right-click menu. Read-only check of ~/Library/Services showed the new 'Als hmb-Snippet speichern' entry points at target/debug/hmb; a stale pre-rename entry 'Als Microblog-Snippet speichern' (pointing at the removed microblog binary) still exists — the app now shows it in Einstellungen and removes it on 'Neu einrichten'.
